historyIntro: Latest report per reporter in each UTC period. Missing reports are not carried forward. Opt-out removes past contributions too.
semantics: Usage means used at least once since schema consent, not activity in that period. Shares use only reporters that supplied the field; older schemas and configuration-only signals can be unknown.
error: Could not load data. Check your access and connection, then try again.
rangeError: Choose a valid range with at most 366 periods. Use weeks or months for longer ranges.
notCollected: Actual use is not collected for this capability. Select configuration to see its history.
dataIntro: Browse every reporter, inspect original reports and export all retained contributions: registration metadata, snapshots, reports, feedback, votes and operation receipts.
accessDisclosure: Who can read the data: participants can access shared aggregates and history, plus their own original reports. Maintainers can inspect and export all retained reporter contributions, including original reports and private feedback. This does not grant permission to publish private feedback. Opt-out removes the reporter’s data and historical contributions.
noPackets: This reporter has not sent a report yet.
workspaceIntro: Maintainers can access all retained usage contributions and cross-reporter history. Publishing feedback still requires the author’s permission. Access tokens stay in page memory.
inventorySemantics: Sum of each reporter’s last report in the period, including drafts and archived records. Videos are not photos. Missing values in older schemas are unknown; changes in reporting installations change the total.
inventorySummary: Sum of the latest report per reporter. No per-gallery breakdown, filenames or image contents.
inventoryCatalog: Totals describe currently stored database records, not upload activity or unique files. Thumbnails and videos are excluded from the photo total. Only these two numbers leave the installation.
distributionSemantics: Shares use only reporters that supplied the selected field. Missing or null fields are unknown; an empty layout list means no layouts reported.
downloadSignals: Allowed downloads (v2/v3) and restricted downloads (v4) are separate questions. Different galleries can make both true. Older values are never inverted or converted; missing values stay unknown.
